verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents an integrations catalog of auditor-vetted native integrations that connect business tools and automatically collect compliance data (thoropass-docs-21, thoropass-docs-67, thoropass-docs-35). The evidence explicitly names only cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), which feed monitors (thoropass-docs-54), plus an IP allowlist for daily or ad-hoc data refreshes (thoropass-docs-74). missing for 10: evidence of identity, HR, code hosting, MDM and ticketing integrations, documentation of read-only permission scopes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
